concerns.text: FR-004 requires Type I error estimation by shuffling group labels on the filtered real datasets. The plan replaces this with a simulated‑null approach (see Phase 3) and only mentions label‑shuffling as a sanity‑check, leaving the primary FR unmet.

FR-008 mandates a Friedman test (non‑parametric repeated‑measures ANOVA) for assessing transformation effects. The plan instead specifies a GLMM (binomial) in Phase 11, which does not satisfy the required Friedman test methodology.
